decision: gated scripts/bot-e2e.ts on the DeepSeek balance: GET /user/balance (no tokens spent) before any phase, skipping with exit 0 when is_available=false and printing the balance figure; the model-driven phases were measured while the key was funded and are not rerunnable now that it is overdrawn, and the harness now skips on that

evidence: scripts/bot-e2e.ts; the probe on this box returned is_available=false with total_balance=-0.02 CNY
result: absent key prints "skipped: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set" and exits 0; overdrawn key prints "skipped: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY reports no balance (is_available=false, total_balance=-0.02 CNY); fund the key to run the phases" and exits 0 in about a second

decision: asserted transcript.sessions.length >= 1 on both the first and the second GET /api/bots/:bot/transcript call in phase 6
why: the second transcript call was printed and never checked, so an empty session list could pass unnoticed
result: both transcript calls assert the session list

decision: kept phase 9's event window open until the interval tick's own turn is inside it (its agent events or a bot status change after the woke-on-interval notice)
why: the window ended at the notice, so the no-chat-sessions-event claim could pass vacuously over an idle gap that contained no tick
result: the window contains a whole tick, so the claim is falsifiable rather than vacuous

decision: started an approval's expiry when the request becomes the head of the queue, not when it is enqueued; arming happens only on promotion to the head, and every removal (resolve, deny, denyAll, denyRob, allowDuplicates, or an expiry) arms the new head if one exists, with denyAll/denyRob clearing the armed timer
why: the client shows only the first request, so a queued approval is invisible and could be auto-denied while the user worked on the first
result: only the head expires at its deadline; the queued request survives the head's deadline and expires on its own later deadline, with the deny reason naming the timeout; the external API, default timeout, and injectable scheduler are unchanged

decision: serialized every read-modify-write of one bot's record on a per-bot promise chain inside the store instance, so commit and saveMemory and their concurrent callers cannot interleave
why: commit and saveMemory were two unlocked read-modify-writes of the same file, and the e2e's own 3000ms wake makes that concurrency routine; one commit could be clobbered by a memory edit
result: a concurrent commit and saveMemory leave both effects on disk; two processes on one data root remain unsafe by design, with no cross-process locking attempted

decision: made TeamHub.forgetMemory fail with UnknownMemoryEntryError when the bot's record has no entry with that id, without writing, and the route maps that error to 404
why: forgetMemory reported success for an id that did not exist, and the client callback discards the promise, so a no-op delete read as success
result: an unknown id surfaces an error, writes nothing, and answers HTTP 404; a real id still succeeds

decision: stated in docs/audit/web-ux.md that the model-driven phases were measured on a funded key and are not rerunnable now that it is overdrawn, that the harness now skips on that, and that deleting a memory entry removes it from the prompt but not the text already inside the ledger's turn log or the live replay
why: the audit framed memory deletion only as a testing limitation and left the funded-key assumption implicit

decision: A bot can be edited and deleted on the server: my-agent.json gains updateRob/removeRob on the shared writeChain, the team drops one rob (stopping its loop, disarming its wake, denying its pending approval), the bot's ledger file goes, and PATCH/DELETE /api/bots/:bot serve it
why: the config was append-only, so a mis-created bot could never be fixed or removed, and deleting had to also delete the durable record or the name would come back with its old memory
evidence: test/config/project-file.test.ts, test/rob/team.test.ts, test/serve/bot-routes-http.test.ts; pnpm bot:e2e phases 10-11 PASS
